description_en: Attaches an instance RAM role to one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 本接口用于为一台或多台ECS实例授予RAM角色
kebab_example: aliyun ecs attach-instance-ram-role --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-ram-role-name testRamRoleName --instance-ids i-bp14ss25xca5ex1u0000_,_i-bp154z5o1qjalfse0000_,_i-bp10ws62o04ubhvi0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachInstanceRamRole

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance RAM role. You can call the RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html to query the instance RAM roles that you have created
parameters.help_zh: 实例RAM角色名称。您可以使用RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html查询您已创建的实例RAM角色
parameters.name: ram_role_name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID array. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The additional access policy. You can specify an additional access policy to further restrict the permissions of the RAM role. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93732.html. Length: 1 to 1,024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 额外权限策略。可以指定一个额外的权限策略，以进一步限制RAM角色的权限。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93732.html。长度为1~1024个字符
parameters.name: policy

FailCount.description_en: The number of instances to which the instance RAM role failed to be attached
FailCount.description_zh: 授予实例RAM角色的实例失败个数

RamRoleName.description_en: The name of the instance RAM role

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances to which the instance RAM role is attached
TotalCount.description_zh: 授予实例RAM角色的实例总个数
